title: Neighbourhood A → Destination B
source: Synthetic fixture created by Lumba Digital to test the interface. No real journey, road alignment, fare or travel time is represented.
limitations: Baseline waits are synthetic fixed inputs, not headway-derived estimates.
Proposal waiting uses headway / 2 only for the hypothetical regular service.
Return onboard time is assumed equal to outbound time for fleet calculation.
Traffic scales onboard minutes, including stops; walking and fixed baseline waits stay unchanged.
No inference about demand, profitability or actual services is possible.
